cases.title: The ageing figures come from a single aggregate query — no per-invoice work in Java, no N+1
cases.steps: Read DashboardService.outstandingByAge; time the endpoint for a 9-invoice book and for the whole database
cases.expected: one CriteriaQuery with a sum/count pair per bucket, executed once via getSingleResult(); no repository call per invoice
cases.actual: outstandingByAge builds 5 x (Aggregates.sumWhen + Aggregates.countWhen) into one multiselect and runs em.createQuery(cq).getSingleResult() once (DashboardService.java:104-115); Invoice#isOverdue is never called on this path. Latency: 3ms for a 9-invoice book vs 3ms for every invoice in the database
